subject: U7: test migration — workspaces-daemon + lib repoRoot container-root hardening
description:
Final unit: migrate the tests U3 intentionally broke, reconcile the auto-filed follow-up, and harden repoRoot in the lib. Depends on U2+U3 (both merged on orch/feature/ws-registry).

Scope:
1. test/workspaces-daemon.test.js: migrate the ~13 assertions that assert the OLD flat default /workspaces shape to the NEW grouped shape `[{name, repos:[{path,name,current}], current}]`. Keep/add a case asserting `?flat=1` still returns the legacy flat shape. Add a case asserting the orphan "(unregistered)" bucket. (Note: U2 already updated section (D) for the v2 on-disk shape — don't undo that.) There is an auto-filed follow-up task `followup/u7-update-workspaces-daemon-test-js-for--d0n3` covering this same test — fold it in and mark/close it (set_status done or record a note) so it isn't left dangling.
2. test/registered-workspace-sweeps.test.js + test/per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js: confirm green (per-repo expected 41, sweeps 13). Update fixtures to v2 registry shape only if needed (migration should keep v1 fixtures working).
3. lib/workspace-registry.js repoRoot HARDENING: U3 added a container-root guard (don't adopt an incidental ancestor .graph at tmpdir/homedir/fs-root) LOCALLY in routes/meta.js. Hoist that guard into repoRoot itself so ALL callers (mcp-graph.js, hooks, CLI) benefit, and add a test for it in test/workspace-registry.test.js. If you change repoRoot, you may then simplify the local guard in routes/meta.js OR leave it as defense-in-depth (note your choice). Keep test/workspace-registry.test.js green (was 38).
4. FULL SUITE: run the whole test suite against the feature worktree (find the runner — package.json "test" script or the test/ files individually) and report the full pass/fail tally. This is the gate evidence before the feature→main merge.

Read actual current files first. You ARE permitted to touch lib/workspace-registry.js, routes/meta.js (only to simplify the now-redundant guard), and test/*. Do NOT touch daemon.js/mcp-graph.js/hooks/CLI. Report the final full-suite tally explicitly.
